descFull: Snow Shot is free, open-source screenshot software and a screen recording tool for Windows and macOS, with annotation, scrolling screenshots, offline OCR and image pinning. 免费开源截图软件，支持截图标注、滚动长截图、离线 OCR、贴图与录屏。
